how: We read the website of every Charleston wedding DJ listed on Lazo (38 listings, 21 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: photo booth rental companies, a Georgia-based DJ company, a multi-city DJ company with a Charleston page, a multi-service chain, planners, and a duplicate listing. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you handle a ceremony on the lawn and a reception inside: separate speakers and a wireless mic for the officiant?
Which downtown venues have you played, and how do you work within Charleston's noise ordinance and end times?
What is in the base package, and what do uplighting, a sax player, cold sparks or extra hours add?

picks.name: Mike Bills Entertainment
picks.blurb: Mike Bills runs an owner-operated Charleston wedding DJ service built on classy, fun receptions with a focus on the music. He became a DJ by chance, grew up on his Baby Boomer parents' records, and advises couples to book the DJ right after the venue.

picks.name: DJ Rehab- Weddings and Special Events
picks.blurb: DJ Rehab Events says it was voted best entertainment service by readers of The Post and Courier and the Charleston City Paper. The site posts recaps of named couples' weddings, from the South Carolina Aquarium on, and offers uplighting and a music app of its own.

picks.name: Dream Day Charleston
picks.blurb: Dream Day Charleston fields wedding DJs, DJ-plus-sax sets, live musicians, photo booths, lighting and cold sparks for couples who want a packed dance floor with a modern vibe. Its style, in its words, is club with class, not the typical cheesy wedding DJ.

picks.name: We Dream Charleston
picks.blurb: We Dream Charleston pairs its DJs with sax, cold sparks, a photobooth, uplighting and dancing-on-a-cloud effects. The Summerville company describes a heart-first approach, from a free consultation through a streamlined planning process to the last dance.

picks.name: Elite Events Charleston
picks.blurb: Elite Events Charleston is a one-owner operation where the owner is the primary DJ, with more than 300 South Carolina events behind him. Photobooth and lighting come from the same team, and he travels to Mt Pleasant, Moncks Corner, Kiawah, Isle of Palms and Summerville.

picks.name: The Dance Doctors
picks.blurb: DJ Earl Newell's Dance Doctors covers Charleston weddings along with silent headphone events, quinceaneras and company parties, with uplighting and a large song library. Based in Summerville, DJ and emcee in one.

picks.name: The Party Music
picks.blurb: Roy Palmgren brings 35-plus years in music as a sound engineer and musician to The Party Music, a North Charleston DJ service for all occasions. He treats each event as a one-time chance to get it right, and the site addresses the party and the reception separately.

picks.name: More Than Music LLC
picks.blurb: Seth Brown founded More Than Music to book DJs, bands and solo artists across the Lowcountry from Summerville, with photo booth rentals, karaoke and trivia alongside weddings. One call covers the ceremony musician and the reception DJ.

picks.name: Primetime Event Djs
picks.blurb: DJ Gino Monteleone has DJed clubs, weddings and corporate events for more than 20 years, from New York originally and long settled in Myrtle Beach. Primetime's wedding package covers up to five hours, a wireless ceremony and cocktail speaker and a lapel or handheld mic for the officiant.

picks.name: Hubbell Entertainment
picks.blurb: Hubbell Entertainment in Myrtle Beach offers DJ, master of ceremonies and sound production with over twenty years of professional experience and a library covering eleven decades of music. A process-driven approach is the pitch, with event coordination on the side.

picks.name: Grade A Entertainment/Ntranze Music, LLC
picks.blurb: Ntranze is a high-energy variety party band that performs old and new party songs, and every booking includes DJ/G the Entertainer so the floor never goes quiet between sets. Weddings, corporate events and festivals across the Carolinas, out of Myrtle Beach.
